subject.title: Redesign publish plugin & skill empty states

question: Should new skill/plugin publishing hide metadata fields until upload, instead of keeping the current disabled or editable pre-upload form visible?
rationale: The diff is mostly correct mechanically, but the central change is a visible publish-flow UX choice rather than a pure bug fix.

options.title: Accept Upload-First Empty States
options.body: Proceed with this direction after the contributor adds real-browser proof for both /skills/publish and /plugins/publish.

options.title: Keep Metadata Preview Visible
options.body: Ask for a narrower revision that preserves the current visible metadata form while improving copy and disabled-state clarity.

options.title: Scope To Plugin Publish Only
options.body: Accept hiding locked plugin metadata before upload but keep skill metadata editable until a separate design pass decides that workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept Upload-First Empty States
recommendation.body: Proceed with this direction after the contributor adds real-browser proof for both /skills/publish and /plugins/publish.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-history owner for the publish routes and recent staged publish workflow behavior.
